verdict.rationale: Steel's 'Reusing Context & Auth' docs describe keeping authenticated state across multiple sessions so agents can reach protected resources without repeating the login process. The docs homepage also lists 'persistent profiles' as a core feature, which directly matches the story. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how profiles are created, stored and reattached (cookies/localStorage capture and lifecycle), and independent or hands-on corroboration that saved logins survive across runs.
